integrity: A complete analytical proof of the special-case formulas is supplied, using an independently published general theorem for the dimension identity. A finite standalone checker supports but does not certify infinite conclusions; independent external validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Specific to similarities x/2,(x+1)/2,(x+1)/4 and strictly positive weights. The general exact-overlap dimension theorem is prior work; only explicit semigroup word-growth/entropy formula and specialization are assessed here. Potential equivalent specializations in renewal-code literature remain possible.
title: Exact word-growth and entropy loss for the three-generator dyadic overlap semigroup
